composition: near-square photorealistic tasbih stage with full terminal, braided loop and tassel inside the canvas

thumbnails.note: 256 x 256 selector thumbnails, re-cut from the approved V3 source board on a shared centre line and a shared crop size. The delivered set was clipped at the bottom on all six, sat ~24 px low and spread 22.5 px horizontally; these measure within 1 px of centre with a 3 px diameter spread. The stage plates are untouched.

provenance.why: docs/FAITH_TASBIH_STRAND_ASSET_CONTRACT.md § Licensing requires the commissioning record to sit beside the hashes. This block is that record. It is deliberately incomplete rather than plausible: the fields marked unknown could not be established from anything this repository holds.
provenance.howTheUnknownsWereEstablished: The twelve PNGs carry no tEXt, iTXt, zTXt or tIME chunk — only IHDR/IDAT/IEND — so no tool or timestamp is embedded. No file under docs/ records the V4 delivery, and no commit message names a tool, an operator or a supplier. Absence of evidence was recorded as unknown rather than filled in by inference.
provenance.mediumNote: The repository describes the pack both as a photorealistic illustration set and, in tasbih-screen.tsx, as "a photograph, not a cutout". The latter is about the missing alpha channel rather than the capture medium, so neither settles what this artwork actually is.
provenance.sourceBoard: The thumbnails were re-cut from the approved V3 source board. That board is not in this repository and its location is unknown — requires owner confirmation

established.pngColourType: 2 (truecolour), 8 bit, no alpha channel on any of the twelve
established.allTwelveHashesVerified: 2026-08-15, against the sha256 values in this file
established.carriesNoText: Verified by rendering all six stage plates and all six thumbnails on an Android release build: no text, no Arabic, no logo, no watermark and no signature appears in any of them. The artwork therefore carries no religious content and states nothing a user could act on.

provenance.releaseImpact: None on screen. This is a record-keeping obligation rather than a rights question in dispute, but the owner must close it before release: NoorLife cannot presently evidence who made this artwork or under what terms.
